phases.title: Prep Week

phases.title: Exam Week
phases.description: Four 2-hour papers (Chemistry, Physics, Maths, SAT); remaining time for analysis and weak areas.

recurring.title: Current project / course
recurring.notes: Work on the active project (or current course). Add project/course tasks — they slot into this block.

recurring.title: Exam paper (2h)
recurring.notes: One of Chemistry / Physics / Maths / SAT. Run it as a paper in Papers so score, accuracy and questions are recorded.

recurring.title: Reflection + plan tomorrow
recurring.notes: What did I finish? What did I learn? What went wrong? What needs fixing? How am I feeling? What is tomorrow's priority?

recurring.title: Optional anime, music, free time or extra study
Sunday test
recurring.notes: Record it as a paper so score and accuracy count.

recurring.title: Weekly reflection
recurring.notes: Academics, skills, cybersecurity, projects, fitness, SAT, energy, streak, schedule adherence — then plan next week.
